summary: Phase 11 (Sortable Storefronts + Weekly Recap) fully validated. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend end-to-end verified: admin drag-and-drop reorder posts to /api/admin/stores/reorder (200), the new order persists after reload, Save button is properly gated by dirty state, and all required data-testids are present on both /admin/stores and /store/analytics. Weekly Recap empty-state renders correctly for a seller with no last-week orders. Admin shelves drag/toggle regression page still loads fine.
action_items: Doc-only nit: The review_request states Weekly Recap Card renders on /dashboard, but the actual route in App.js is /store/analytics (StoreAnalytics page). No code fix needed — either update the request doc or add a /dashboard alias route pointing to StoreAnalytics.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/discovery.py lines 150-153: the weekly-recap timezone-normalization expression is duplicated 4x inside a comprehension — extract a helper `_normalize(dt, tz)` to improve readability and reduce risk.

server.py /admin/stores/reorder loops individual update_one calls (O(N) round-trips). For N up to ~20 storefronts this is fine, but consider bulk_write with UpdateOne operations if the store count grows.
/admin/stores/reorder does not validate that provided ids actually exist; unknown ids silently no-op. Consider returning a 404 or a `matched` count so admin UI can surface stale/invalid rows.
server.py is now 2680 lines — continues to grow. Splitting into per-domain routers (stores/admin/wallet/…) is still recommended (already flagged in iteration_5).
test_credentials: admin@mercari.local / admin123 (admin), urban_finds@demo.local / demo1234 (seller). Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the 2 stores already seeded (Urban Finds Boutique + Test Store). After reorder tests the original order is restored to avoid polluting downstream tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 11 (drag-and-drop stores + weekly recap) is stable. Cumulative backend regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_phase{1..5,11}_*.py. Weekly Recap sub-testids (recap-earnings/orders/delta/suggestion/recap-top-product) were NOT exercised on a seller with real last-week orders because the seed data has no such orders — the empty-state path (weekly-recap-empty + recap-no-top-product) rendered correctly instead, which is the acceptable branch per the request. If future data is seeded with last-week orders, the populated branch should also be validated. Login button selector matters: use get_by_role('button', name='Log in', exact=True) — a generic button[type='submit'] also matches the header search form and silently fails to authenticate.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in Phase 11.
